name: copy_two_pointers_from_table

name: load_icon_object_from_header
description: Obtains an object and reads a header into a stack buffer through a library call. On success it copies the ten longwords and the individual fields from that buffer into the object at fixed offsets, links the object into its parent at offset 424 when a parent is set, and returns the object; on failure it releases the object and returns zero.

name: copy_header_fields_to_object
description: Copies ten longwords and several individual fields from a stack buffer into the object at fixed offsets, then links the object into its parent when one is set. It is the copy step of the header load without the reading.

name: return_zero_stub

name: copy_icon_data_to_stack
description: Copies ten longwords and several fields from the object at offset 96 onward into a local buffer on the stack, sets two leading constant words in that buffer, and passes its address to another routine together with the first two arguments.

name: load_info_icon_file
description: Works with the .info icon file suffix, opens the file through a library call and reads its header into the caller's structure. It checks the header magic and version, then reads the remaining icon data and fills in the structure's pointers, returning one on success; on failure it releases the handle and returns zero.

name: read_icon_file_sections
description: Reads the optional icon sections from an already open file, checking the header magic and version first. It obtains memory for each flagged section and fills in the structure's pointers, returning one when every read succeeds and zero otherwise.

name: read_icon_optional_fields
description: Reads two longwords from an open file and stores them in the structure, then reads optional values for the fields at offsets 50, 54 and 70, where the field at 54 receives a counted list of longwords. Returns one when all reads succeed and zero otherwise.

name: read_counted_longword_list
description: Reads a counted list of longwords through a callback pointer, reading each length, obtaining a buffer for it and reading its data, until the remaining count runs out. It then reads an optional value for the field at offset 70 and returns one on success or zero on failure.

name: call_routine_and_return_zero

name: return_immediately

name: load_icon_with_work_buffer
description: Obtains a 260-byte work buffer, then reads the icon header and its optional sections into the structure through the routines it calls. It releases the buffer before returning the success flag, and if the buffer cannot be obtained it calls a failure routine with code 103 and returns zero.

name: open_and_read_info_icon
description: Saves the structure's field at offset 26, opens the .info icon file through a library call at offset minus 30, and reads its header and optional sections through callbacks. It then restores the saved field and returns one on success or zero otherwise.

name: read_optional_icon_fields
description: Reads two longwords from an open file and stores them in the structure, then reads optional values for the fields at offsets 50, 54 and 70, where the field at 54 receives a counted list of longwords. It restores the field at offset 26 before returning one on success or zero on failure.

name: write_icon_pointer_list
description: Walks a null-terminated list of pointers to measure the total length of its entries, then passes each entry's length and data to a callback and handles the optional field at offset 70 the same way. It restores the field at offset 26 before returning.

name: iterate_icon_table_entries
description: Walks a null-terminated table of pointers, computing the length of each entry with a routine call and passing it through two callbacks, then handles the optional field at offset 70 the same way. It restores the field at offset 26 before returning.

name: visit_linked_list_nodes
description: Follows the chain of node pointers stored in the structure, passing each node to another routine, and stops when the list returns to its start or no next node exists. The final node found is passed to the same routine.

name: iterate_linked_list_nodes
description: Repeatedly passes the current node to another routine and advances to the next node, stopping when no node is returned or the structure's offset-8 link is reached. Any remaining node is then passed to that routine once more.

name: forward_call_with_offset_140

name: allocate_and_initialize_record

name: forward_call_and_return

name: decrement_counter_and_store_pair
description: Decrements a short counter through a pointer, then stores two register values into the eight-byte entry at that index of a table referenced from offset 10 of the same block, and returns one.

name: allocate_and_initialize_header_record
description: Obtains a 94-byte cleared record, calls a routine on its field at offset 80, and then calls another routine with the field at offset 78 to set it up. It releases the record if either setup call fails, and otherwise returns the record.

name: find_string_after_equals_sign
description: Scans a null-terminated list of pointers and returns the address just after the first equals sign found at the matched position. It returns zero when the list ends without one.

name: scan_pointer_list_for_value
description: Walks a null-terminated list of pointers, calling a routine on each entry, and returns the address just after the equals sign when the check passes. It returns zero when the end of the list is reached.

name: match_pipe_separated_item
description: Checks whether a string equals one of the items in a string separated by the pipe character, returning one on a match and zero otherwise.

name: find_pipe_item_of_length

name: parse_decimal_copy_number
description: Reads a decimal number from the text at offset 5 of the structure after matching a three-character marker, and calls two routines to finish the update whether or not a number was read.

name: parse_decimal_digits
description: Accumulates decimal digits from the text pointer until a non-digit is reached, then checks the four characters after the number when one was read. Two routine calls finish the update whichever way the check goes.

name: parse_copy_number_suffix
description: Reads the decimal copy number from the text, checks the four characters that follow it, and finishes with two routine calls whichever way the check goes.

name: convert_digit_char_to_value
description: Returns the numeric value of a decimal digit character, or minus one when the character is not a digit.

name: divide_unsigned_32_with_remainder
description: Divides an unsigned 32-bit value by an unsigned divisor and returns the quotient and remainder together. A divisor above the 16-bit range uses a bit-by-bit shift-and-subtract loop, while smaller divisors use direct division.

name: divide_by_shift_subtract_loop
description: Runs a sixteen-step shift-and-subtract loop over a 32-bit value, shifting one bit per step and subtracting the divisor from the high half whenever it is not larger. Each subtraction sets a bit of the quotient, and the quotient and remainder are left in the registers.

name: multiply_32_bit_integers
description: Computes the low 32 bits of the product of two 32-bit values from 16-bit partial products, and returns it together with the second input with its 16-bit halves swapped.

name: call_raw_do_fmt_vector
description: Calls the function at offset minus 522 from a library base stored in a global variable, with no arguments. The library call list identifies that slot as the exec text formatting routine.

name: store_byte_through_pointer
description: Stores the low byte of a data register at the address held in an address register and returns.

name: count_string_length
description: Counts the bytes of a null-terminated string by decrementing a 16-bit counter for each non-zero byte, then returns the count. The result is the string length.

name: find_character_in_string
description: Scans a null-terminated string for the given character and returns a pointer to its first occurrence, or zero if the terminator is reached first.

name: return_zero_stub

name: copy_c_string
description: Copies bytes from a source string to a destination until a zero byte has been copied, advancing both pointers on each step.

name: append_c_string
description: Advances to the terminator of the destination string and copies the source string, including its terminator, after it.

name: compare_strings_up_to_length
description: Compares two strings for at most the given number of characters, returning zero when they match up to a terminator or the limit and one when they differ.

name: return_one_stub

name: call_routine_at_string_end

name: process_icon_request

name: walk_node_list_calling_handlers
description: Walks a linked list of twelve-byte nodes, passing each node to one routine and its data pointer with a size derived from a byte field to another. It returns one when the list ends and zero if either call fails.

name: walk_node_chain_calling_pair
description: Repeatedly calls two routines for the current node and follows the link at offset 12 to the next node. It returns one when the chain ends and zero if either call fails.

name: return_zero_stub

name: allocate_entry_and_store_result

name: link_node_chain_blocks
description: Repeats an allocation step while a chain continues, linking each new node at offset 12 of the previous one and recording a data block at offset 8 of each node. It returns the first node, or minus one when a step fails.

name: fill_node_chain_blocks
description: Fills in the data blocks of an existing node chain, linking each node at offset 12 of the previous one and reading a block for each node at offset 8 until the chain ends. It returns the first node, or minus one if a step fails.

name: increment_counter_clear_flag_bit5

name: decrement_counter_call_if_flagged
description: Decrements the 16-bit field at offset 32 and, when it reaches zero with bit 5 of the byte at offset 14 set, calls another routine and returns its result. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: unlink_node_or_mark_flag
description: If the word at offset 8 of the structure is zero, it unlinks the structure from its neighbours and calls a library function at offset minus 210 from the library base, returning the longword at offset 38. Otherwise it sets bit 5 of the byte at offset 14 and returns zero.

name: unlink_node_and_call_vector
description: Unlinks the structure addressed by an address register from its neighbouring list entries, calls the library function at offset minus 210 from the library base, and returns the longword at offset 38.

name: parse_text_with_hash_markers
description: Fills a 26-byte stack buffer with spaces, then scans the input text for hash markers and space characters, calling other routines to process each marker and the text between them. It returns a 16-bit result.

name: scan_text_field_separators

name: scan_escape_sequences_in_text

name: scan_text_for_escape_markers

name: match_text_until_equals_sign

name: compare_text_until_equals_sign
description: Reads characters until an equals sign. A character of the marked class triggers another pass that calls a routine, and any other character must match the second string or the routine returns.

name: scan_and_copy_text_run
description: Measures a run of text up to a backslash or backtick, then either copies it to the output buffer or, if it would pass a width limit, backs up to a break character and ends the line there. It returns the run's length and position values packed together.

name: copy_text_run_with_wrapping

name: copy_fixed_length_text_run
description: Copies a fixed number of characters from the source text to the output buffer, then sets bit 0 of a status byte, clearing it again when the next source character is a backtick.

name: terminate_text_at_break_character
description: Walks backward from the current output position until a character of the break class is found, then writes a zero byte there to end the line.

description: Calls another routine repeatedly for as long as bit 1 of a data register remains set.

name: call_pair_then_return
description: Calls two routines in sequence and then returns. A test of bit 7 of a data register sits between the calls but does not change the result.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns immediately without doing any work.

name: normalize_text_into_buffer
description: Copies text into a fixed buffer one character at a time, replacing control characters and closing brackets with spaces and converting lowercase letters to uppercase. It stops at a space, a '#' pair, or the 100-character limit, and returns a packed status value.

name: write_space_before_pointer
description: Writes a space character two bytes before the address held in an address register and returns.

name: insert_marker_after_vowel_pair
description: Checks the current output position against a table of fourteen two-letter vowel codes held in the data. When a code matches, it shifts the output text along one place and writes a digit four after the match, then stores the new position in the state.

name: shift_text_and_insert_four
description: Moves the output text one place along from the current position to open a gap, writes a digit four into the gap, and stores the new position in the state.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The listing contains only an instruction the decompiler cannot translate, so no behaviour is recovered for this routine. It is the entry point of a library file whose code could not be recovered.

name: store_library_state
description: Stores the caller's frame register and a data register into two fixed global slots, writes the address register value at offset 34 of the structure in the data register, and copies that value into a third global slot.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls another routine and then returns, with no other work on registers or memory.

name: forward_call_and_return

name: forward_call_and_return

name: return_immediately
description: Returns immediately without doing any work.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls another routine and then returns, with no other work on registers or memory.

name: clear_flag_and_increment_counter
description: Clears bit 3 of the byte at offset 14 of the structure, increments the 16-bit field at offset 32, and returns the structure pointer.

name: free_structure_region_when_unused
description: When the 16-bit counter at offset 32 is zero, it calls a routine on the structure, releases the memory block that starts before the structure, sized by two 16-bit fields at offsets 16 and 18, and calls a routine again before returning a value saved in a global. Otherwise it sets bit 3 of the byte at offset 14 and returns zero.

name: release_structure_block
description: Releases the memory block that starts before the structure, sized by two 16-bit fields at offsets 16 and 18, between two calls to other routines, then returns a value saved in a global.

name: decrement_library_refcount
description: Decrements the 16-bit counter at offset 32 of the structure and, when it reaches zero with bit 3 of the byte at offset 14 set, calls another routine and returns its result. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns the constant zero and does no other work.

name: process_nonzero_pointer_slots
description: Passes each non-zero pointer among its arguments and several global slots to another routine, passing a flag of one for the second argument when it is set. It returns nothing.

name: allocate_info_block_and_layout
description: Allocates a 944-byte cleared block and stores pointers to fixed offsets inside it in several globals. It copies template values from a global area into the sub-blocks, links them together, and returns one, or zero if the allocation fails.

name: initialize_info_block_layout
description: Sets pointers to fixed offsets inside the structure addressed by an address register and copies template values from a global area into each sub-block. It links the sub-blocks together and returns one.

name: open_four_library_bases
description: Calls a routine with the shared library name buffer and a zero argument four times, storing each result in a global. A failed call reports error code 3, 4 or 5 through another routine, and the function returns zero on failure and one when all four calls succeed.

name: open_three_library_bases
description: Calls a routine through a pointer in an address register with the shared library name buffer and a zero argument three times, storing each result in a global. A failure reports error code 3, 4 or 5 through another routine and returns zero; otherwise it returns one.

name: open_two_library_bases
description: Calls a routine with the shared library name buffer and a zero argument twice, storing each result in a global. A failure reports error code 4 or 5 through another routine and returns zero; otherwise it returns one.

name: open_one_library_base
description: Calls a routine with the shared library name buffer and a zero argument once, storing the result in a global. On failure it reports error code 5 through another routine, and it returns whether the result was non-zero.

name: return_one_stub
description: Returns the constant one and does no other work.

name: lookup_info_field_value
description: Returns the value at offset 164 of the global structure when it is set. Otherwise it returns the longword at offset 442 of the structure linked at offset 76, which is the global structure itself when the type byte at offset 61 is one, or the structure at offset 56 otherwise; it returns zero when the global pointer is null or the type byte equals seven.

name: lookup_info_field_value_direct
description: Works on the structure addressed by an address register and returns zero when its type byte at offset 61 is seven. Otherwise it returns the value at offset 164 when set, or the longword at offset 442 of the structure linked at offset 76, chosen by the type byte as before.

name: lookup_info_field_untyped
description: Returns the value at offset 164 when it is set. Otherwise it returns the longword at offset 442 of the structure linked at offset 76, using the structure itself when the type byte at offset 61 is one and the structure at offset 56 otherwise, and zero when that link is missing.

name: lookup_info_field_from_register
description: Returns the longword at offset 442 of the structure linked at offset 76, using the structure itself when the type byte at offset 61 is one, or the structure passed in an address register otherwise. It returns zero when that register holds nothing.
